title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.dvd_lcm_of_dvd_right
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.dvd_lcm_of_dvd_right` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ∣ b → ∀ (c : ℕ), a ∣ c.lcm b
formal.kernel_statement: theorem Nat.dvd_lcm_of_dvd_right : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.dvd x0 x1) -> AxNat.dvd x0 (AxNat.lcm x2 x1)))))

evidence.supports: a divides b implies, for every c, a divides lcm c b
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- dvd_lcm_of_dvd_right 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.dvd_lcm_of_dvd_right[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
